note: The Sunken Crypt dungeon now has named bosses: Grimmaw the Hollow Alpha, Mother Vexa the Ember Matron, Scribe Morvain Keeper of Bone, and Warden Karst the Last Warden. Each appears at most once per descent, guards a hand-crafted chamber, and drops bonus gold and a potion when it falls. Also fixed: one dungeon vault could wall off a corridor and strand the rooms behind it — vault placement now re-checks reachability after every vault it stamps
